source.note: Recorded from a clean checkout of the commit named in head (git status was empty when it was written); ordinary Normal gen-2 (arrivals on) at tick 48000, the rules 260 and 261 pin world, kept because it already holds state rules 262 added: one fire that has had a song (Building.sung) and four feasts at which people have danced (Occasion.dance: 27 dancers recorded, 22 of them long enough to count, the one line written at all four); it holds no reunion cue, no reunion run and no dance in progress at that tick, and gen-2 at tick 60000 held none of those either (one fire with a song, seven dance feasts), so a reunion and a dancer caught mid-dance are not exercised by this pin and are covered by the staged tests only; saved and continued 120 ticks.
